tagline.en: Let AI operate your phone, hands-free
tagline.he: נותנים ל-AI להפעיל את הטלפון, בלי ידיים

description.en: Touchless connects AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini to your Android phone over MCP. The AI can open apps, read the screen, tap and type, send messages, build automations and run whole tasks for you, while you decide what it is allowed to do.
description.he: Touchless מחברת עוזרי AI כמו Claude, ChatGPT ו-Gemini לטלפון האנדרואיד שלכם דרך MCP. ה-AI יכול לפתוח אפליקציות, לקרוא את המסך, להקיש ולהקליד, לשלוח הודעות, לבנות אוטומציות ולבצע משימות שלמות בשבילכם, ואתם קובעים מה מותר לו.

release.name: Touchless v0.2.610
release.notes:
# v0.2.610

Hands-free unlock: a pattern or a password is no longer stopped by one unclear try (#996).

- **Password lock:** Touchless checks that the whole password is in the field before it confirms, and decides "code
  refused" from the field, as it does for a PIN.
- **Pattern lock:** one try that leaves the phone locked without a clear refusal no longer stops hands-free unlock.
  It stops only after two such tries in a row, and a successful unlock starts the count again.
- The same two-try rule covers phones whose lock-screen keys only Shizuku can see.

description.en: SeretGram turns the films and series in your Telegram chats into a library with posters, cast and genres. Continue where you stopped, watch together with friends, open Live TV, and use the phone as a remote for SeretGram on Android TV. Your library syncs between the phone and the TV.
description.he: SeretGram הופכת את הסרטים והסדרות שבצ'אטים שלכם בטלגרם לספרייה עם פוסטרים, שחקנים וז'אנרים. ממשיכים מאיפה שעצרתם, צופים יחד עם חברים, פותחים שידורים חיים, ומשתמשים בטלפון כשלט ל-SeretGram ב-Android TV. הספרייה מסתנכרנת בין הטלפון לטלוויזיה.

description.en: An immersive, TikTok-style vertical feed of still and live (video) wallpapers. Double-tap to keep a favourite, set real live wallpapers, search the gallery and turn your own videos into live wallpapers. Fits every screen, foldables included. Free, with no ads.
description.he: פיד אנכי סוחף בסגנון טיקטוק של טפטים רגילים וטפטים חיים (וידאו). הקשה כפולה שומרת למועדפים, אפשר להגדיר טפט חי אמיתי, לחפש בגלריה ולהפוך סרטונים משלכם לטפטים חיים. מתאים לכל מסך, כולל מתקפלים. חינם וללא פרסומות.

release.name: Wallify 0.7.2
release.notes:
- **Everything is open to everyone**: no Premium, no paywall, no ads. The gallery (Discover) with search and
  filters, and your own videos as live wallpapers (Love it → My videos), work for everyone. Google Play Billing
  and the AdMob / consent SDKs are gone from the app - no advertising id, no consent form at start.
- **Updates from the public releases**: Wallify is not in a store, so every version is also published to
  [il90il90/Wallify-releases](https://github.com/il90il90/Wallify-releases). On launch (at most every few hours)
  the app looks there and, for a newer version, asks whether to update, with what is new. *Update* downloads it,
  checks its SHA-256 and that it is Wallify, and opens Android's installer (the first time, Android asks to allow
  Wallify to install apps). *Later* asks again on the next launch; Settings → *Check for updates* asks now. The TV
  shows the same question with remote buttons.
- **Shorter Settings**: no Membership, Privacy or policy texts; the *Personalized* and *Keep history* switches are
  gone (the feed is always personal, the history always kept on the phone) - *Reset recommendations* and *Clear
  watch history* remain.
- **No numbers on the tabs**: the count on the heart in the bottom bar, on the Love it tabs and next to the
  categories is hidden.
- **Developer options are hidden**: Settings → tap the version line 10 times (test builds) to show files on the
  Cloudflare server, *Counts* (categories, Love it tabs, the heart), the temporary *Delete* button and *Hide
  developer options*. While they are hidden, the counts and the Delete button are off.
- From 0.7.1: the first version in the public releases; the TV's Settings have *Check for updates* too.

release.name: TrustAPK 1.8.1066
release.notes:
TrustAPK 1.8.1066 (build 2066)

Patch NSC: guarantee a base-config that trusts the capture CA for every domain [skip ci]

An app whose network-security-config only declares domain-configs (with no
trust-anchors of their own) inherits the DEFAULT trust set — system CAs only —
so the embedded capture/user CA is refused there even though the APK carries it.
com.yit.evritViewer is exactly this: its single <trust-anchors> sat inside an
inert <debug-overrides>, and every api.*.e-vrit.co.il handshake rejected the
MITM leaf with SSLV3_ALERT_CERTIFICATE_UNKNOWN. patchExistingConfig only added
our cert to trust-anchors that already existed, which here applied to nothing.

- Always ensure a <base-config> whose trust-anchors trust system + user + our
  cert, inserted FIRST (the framework only lets a domain-config inherit the
  base-config when base-config precedes it in the document).
- Also add our cert (and user) to each domain-config that has its OWN
  trust-anchors, so a domain that overrides the base still trusts us.
- Idempotent: an existing user entry / cert reference is not duplicated, so a
  re-patch stays clean.

New Axml helpers: firstChildElement, hasCertificatesReference, prependElement.
Verified offline against the real e-vrit APK: the patched NSC now leads with
base-config(system,user,@cert) and the e-vrit.co.il domain-config inherits it.

tagline.en: Turn your TVs into a living photo wall
tagline.he: הופכים את הטלוויזיות לקיר תמונות חי

description.en: Install it on your phone and on your TVs: the phone is the remote and the TVs are the displays. Share photos and videos straight from your gallery into albums and they appear on the screens over your home Wi-Fi.
description.he: מתקינים בטלפון ובטלוויזיות: הטלפון הוא השלט והטלוויזיות הן התצוגה. משתפים תמונות וסרטונים ישר מהגלריה לאלבומים, והם מופיעים על המסכים דרך ה-Wi-Fi הביתי.

release.name: v3.3.0
release.notes:
## What's new

**Share photos straight from your gallery**
Select photos (and videos) in your phone's gallery, tap **Share** and pick **Gallery Wall**. Before anything is sent, Gallery Wall asks which album they go into — one of your albums, a **New album**, or **All photos** — then the upload quality, and the photos land in that album on your screen.

- **No limit** on how many you share at once (the in-app picker stops at about 100).
- It sends to the screen this phone last controlled; if that one can't be reached, you pick a screen (and enter its PIN if it has one). **Change** switches screens.
- The upload runs in the background with a progress notification, so you can go straight back to your gallery.

**More reliable long uploads**
A long upload no longer stops part-way when you close Gallery Wall (or the gallery) while it is still sending.

tagline.en: IPTV and camera streams on phone, TV and watch

description.en: Watch IPTV channels and RTSP camera streams on your phone, Android TV and Wear OS watch. Nothing is built in: you add your own playlists and streams, and they are stored encrypted on your device. The phone can send its whole library to the watch and to every TV on your Wi-Fi.
description.he: צופים בערוצי IPTV ובמצלמות RTSP בטלפון, ב-Android TV ובשעון Wear OS. שום דבר לא מובנה מראש: אתם מוסיפים פלייליסטים וזרמים משלכם, והם נשמרים מוצפנים במכשיר. הטלפון יכול לשלוח את כל הספרייה לשעון ולכל טלוויזיה ב-Wi-Fi.

tagline.en: A scoreboard on your phone, watch and TV

description.en: A sports scoreboard for phones, tablets and foldables. A Wear OS watch works as the scoring remote, the TV shows a live scoreboard, and the app keeps the game clock and saves your scores.
description.he: לוח תוצאות לספורט לטלפונים, לטאבלטים ולמתקפלים. שעון Wear OS משמש כשלט לניקוד, הטלוויזיה מציגה לוח תוצאות חי, והאפליקציה מנהלת את שעון המשחק ושומרת את התוצאות.

release.name: ScoreUp 1.0.18
release.notes:
Heart rate, clock and restart on the watch, saved scores, bigger TV scoreboard

Watch
- Live heart rate from the watch sensor while ScoreUp is open (asks for sensor
  access once; on/off switch in the watch controls). Shown on the score page
  and sent to the phone, which shows it on the scoreboard and the TV.
- Centre strip: undo | game clock (always visible) over the time of day and
  heart rate | new restart button. Restart asks first, then saves the score
  and starts over. Controls also get Reset clock.
- Saved scores: every restarted match is kept on the watch with its average
  and peak heart rate; "Save score" saves at any time; new Saved scores page.
- Score digits laid out by glyph height, so both team names fit on round screens.

Phone
- "Save score" in the menu (saving the same match again updates its entry).
- Watch heart rate next to the period label; period label no longer renders
  near-black on the dark theme.

TV (TV mode, external display)
- Redesigned arena board: each score is sized to fill its team panel (about
  50% of the screen height for two digits), team-colored panels and glow,
  period + game clock pill, time of day, heart rate and LIVE badge.

Also: history store moved to :shared for phone + watch; onArchive installed
before sync starts; Release workflow tags the built commit.
